headline: Nigeria Reports Electricity Generation Decline Due to Gas Supply Constraints
summary: The Nigerian Independent System Operator reported a decline in electricity generation on the national grid, attributing the shortfall to gas supply constraints for thermal plants and reduced hydroelectric output.
why: Energy infrastructure is a critical bottleneck for the Nigerian economy, directly impacting industrial productivity and business costs.

impacts.name: Nigerian Industry
impacts.why: Reduced power supply increases operational costs and limits production capacity for businesses.
